{{Quote|Approximately 12,000 BBY a theocratic conspiracy, centuries in the offing, impeached Chancellor Pers'lya and placed its own man, Contispex, in the seat.|Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>}}
'''Pers'lya''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who became the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]. In [[11,987 BBY]], Pers'lya was impeached due to the manipulations of the [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] religious group [[Pius Dea]], which sought to place [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]], an adherent of their religion, in power. After his impeachment, Pers'lya was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], and Contispex was placed into [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|office]] as Supreme Chancellor; he went on to [[First Pius Dea Crusade|initiate]] the [[Pius Dea Crusades]].

==Biography==
Pers'lya, a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]<ref name="TTSPendnotes" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the governing body of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was successful in his bid for the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] at some point before [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]].<ref name="TTSP" /> However, in [[11,987 BBY]], Pers'lya was impeached during his term by the Senate,<ref name="EGTW" /> due to the manipulations of a conspiratorial and theocratic sect known as the [[Pius Dea]], whose belief system emphasized [[humanocentrism]].<ref name="GH 19">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 19: The Pius Dea Crusades}}</ref>

Sometime after Pers'lya's impeachment, he was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]]. His successor, [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]]&mdash;who was an adherent of the Pius Dea religion&mdash;took advantage of tensions within the [[Hutt Empire]] that had emerged in the wake of the [[Hutt Cataclysms]].<ref name="GH 19" /> Contispex approved a [[First Pius Dea Crusade|full-scale invasion]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] by the Pius Dea-controlled Republic in [[11,965 BBY]], beginning the [[Pius Dea Crusades]].<ref name="EGTW" />

[[Time/Legends|Millennia]] after Pers'lya's [[Death/Legends|death]], the deposed [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] was mentioned in the historical article "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," written by the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Gabrel Treon]].<ref name="TTSP" /> The article was published circa [[104 ABY]]<ref name="TTSPendnotes" /> by the ''[[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]]''.<ref name="TTSP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pers'lya was first mentioned in the [[2009]] story ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', which was written by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] for the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="TTSP" />
